definitions.explanation: a gift given to celebrate someone's graduation

examples.japanese: {卒業|そつぎょう}{祝|いわ}いに{時計|とけい}をもらった。
examples.english: I received a watch as a graduation gift.

examples.japanese: {姪|めい}の{卒業|そつぎょう}{祝|いわ}いに{何|なに}を{贈|おく}るか{相談|そうだん}した。
examples.english: I discussed what to give my niece for her graduation gift.

examples.japanese: {大学|だいがく}{卒業|そつぎょう}{祝|いわ}いとして{旅行券|りょこうけん}をプレゼントした。
examples.english: I gave a travel voucher as a university graduation celebration gift.

notes:
TIMING:
{卒業|そつぎょう}{祝|いわ}い is typically given around March when most Japanese schools hold graduation ceremonies.

COMMON GIFTS:
- {現金|げんきん} - cash
- {商品券|しょうひんけん} - gift certificates
- ビジネス{用品|ようひん} - business accessories (pen, card case)
- {腕時計|うでどけい} - wristwatch

RELATED OCCASIONS:
{卒業|そつぎょう}{祝|いわ}い is often combined with {入学|にゅうがく}{祝|いわ}い (school entrance gift) or {就職|しゅうしょく}{祝|いわ}い (job celebration gift) when these events occur around the same time.
